source: protocol, client, producer, consumer, and telemetry allocation audit
non_claims: does not prove absence of allocation paths outside the reviewed boundary families
does not replace fuzz campaign duration or crash/OOM disposition
does not certify production memory behavior

entries.validation_point: validate frame length before allocating the response buffer
entries.failure: typed response-frame limit error; malformed framing poisons the connection

entries.input: Kafka array or compact-array element count

entries.limit: non-negative wire length plus remaining-frame bytes
entries.validation_point: reject negative length and read_exact only after checked conversion

entries.limit: non-negative wire length plus remaining-frame bytes
entries.validation_point: reject negative length and verify remaining bytes before to_vec

entries.input: compact length and signed varint encoding
entries.limit: five-byte u32 varint and checked signed conversion
entries.validation_point: stop on VarintTooLong or negative decoded length

entries.input: flexible-version tagged-field count and payload length
entries.validation_point: bound tag count and each tag payload before storage
entries.failure: typed limit, length, or truncation error

entries.input: message-set entry and record-batch byte lengths
entries.limit: remaining frame bytes and configured record decoder limits
entries.validation_point: check entry length and skip incomplete trailing entries without oversized allocation

entries.input: decoded output of Gzip, Snappy, LZ4, or Zstd
entries.validation_point: validate declared window and stream output through a capped reader

entries.input: records returned by one consumer poll
entries.validation_point: truncate decoded records to remaining poll budget
entries.failure: no allocation beyond requested poll budget
entries.allocation_behavior: bounded by remaining poll budget before record allocation

entries.input: records queued for an assigned partition
entries.validation_point: bounded channel applies backpressure before enqueue
entries.failure: typed queue backpressure or closed-queue outcome

entries.input: records grouped into one Produce request
entries.validation_point: chunk records at the configured count before encoding
entries.failure: oversized input is split into bounded batches

entries.validation_point: find largest fitting prefix before request allocation
entries.failure: single oversized record remains isolated and is reported by broker outcome
entries.allocation_behavior: bounded checked size sum before request allocation

entries.validation_point: bounded enqueue channel and pending-delivery state
entries.failure: backpressure, canceled sender, or delivery deadline error
entries.allocation_behavior: bounded channel and pending set before queue growth

entries.limit: minimum of local and broker telemetry payload ceilings
entries.validation_point: check raw and compressed sizes before transmission
